inputs.name: shell thickness
inputs.ref: NOT STATED by the maker. A one-piece card wallet 10 mm deep closed; 1.0 mm is a stand-in for vegetable-tanned horse skin, not a reading

inputs.name: shell stiffness E
inputs.ref: placeholder: the tensile value measured for 1.2 mm CALFskin (Mihai et al., Materials 2022, 15(15):5107); no horse-skin value is on record. The maker says the leather 'is designed to stretch to fit' cards, which this elastic model does not capture

inputs.name: cards
inputs.ref: the 10 mm depth is the maker's figure; whether it was taken empty is not stated

inputs.name: closed thickness at the spine
inputs.ref: maker's page (corpus SRW11): 'Dimensions of WHALET - 85 mm x 100 mm x 10 mm'. Not checked, and not said whether it is empty or loaded

inputs.name: flap hinge (right end): stack it wraps (derived from the closed thickness)
inputs.ref: derived: closed thickness 10 mm - 2 x 1 mm of shell; the lower bound 4 mm is assumed (the pack compresses). the flap closes over everything but the outer layers; the lower bound 4 mm is assumed (an empty wallet with slack panels is thinner than the stated depth)

inputs.name: left end fold: stack it wraps (derived from the closed thickness)
inputs.ref: derived: closed thickness 10 mm - 2 x 1 mm of shell; the lower bound 4 mm is assumed (the pack compresses). the hairpin wrap at the other short end (low view, image 034); assumed to wrap the same pack

inputs.name: closed thickness
inputs.ref: maker's page (corpus SRW11): 'Dimensions of WHALET - 85 mm x 100 mm x 10 mm'. Not checked, and not said whether it is empty or loaded

failure_modes.name: Grain crack at the hinge
failure_modes.text: flap hinge (right end): tension-face strain 10.4 % loose to 11.8 % taut (closed-form limit 11.1 %), inside radius 4.00 mm, R/t = 4.0; within the screening rules. Cycles to crack need flex-test data.

failure_modes.name: Permanent set
failure_modes.text: needs a cyclic viscoplastic model and fold-and-measure data; it is the usual first visible sign of a worn hinge

failure_modes.name: Finish crazing or delamination
failure_modes.text: a film-on-substrate model quoted in prior-research/reference/durability.md section 2b has a stiff finish buckling at 2-12 % compressive strain; at flap hinge (right end) the compression face is -10.6 % and the grain is in tension, not compression

failure_modes.name: Stress at stitch holes
failure_modes.text: the record lists rivets, but whether it crosses or pins a fold is not recorded

failure_modes.name: Skive-line or thickness step
failure_modes.text: whether the folds are skived is not recorded; a skive line is a stiffness step where cracks start

failure_modes.name: Edge paint chipping
failure_modes.text: the edge treatment is not recorded; record it (painted edges chip where they flex)

failure_modes.name: Pocket-mouth and corner abrasion
failure_modes.text: 2 pocket(s) recorded; needs the card-pull scenario (roadmap phase 4) and wear photos to calibrate

failure_modes.name: Perforation tear line
failure_modes.text: no recorded row of holes crosses a fold

failure_modes.name: Layer delamination
failure_modes.text: layers are treated as perfectly bonded; the record does not say what is glued

failure_modes.name: Cold embrittlement
failure_modes.text: needs a cold flex test; no built-in factor

failure_modes.name: Over-drying
failure_modes.text: needs a measured material state (stiffness and strain to crack at a stated humidity)

failure_modes.name: Long-term chemical ageing
failure_modes.text: ageing enters only through measured aged states; none recorded
